title: Circuit Encoding Length Bound
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, and suppose that each gate's argument list is strictly increasing and that the output vertex has index $\mathrm{size}(C)-1$. Then the length of the circuit's encoding is at most $4(\mathrm{size}(C)+1)^3$.
hypotheses_covered: Each gate's argument list is strictly increasing
The output index plus one equals the circuit size
